saints.name: Thomas
saints.legacy: From doubt to faith, a powerful witness.
saints.summary: Thomas was one of the twelve apostles of Jesus, known for his initial doubt about Christ's resurrection. He famously declared, 'My Lord and my God!' upon seeing the risen Christ, symbolizing the journey from doubt to faith. After spreading the Gospel in various regions, he ultimately became a martyr in India, where he is revered as a foundational figure in the Christian community there.
